title: Energy and Engineering Optimization
summary: Optimization and decision support for energy systems and engineering design — finding waste and eliminating it.
argument: Energy systems and engineering design problems are full of invisible waste. The optimization landscape is too complex for intuition alone, and classical methods make assumptions that break down at real-world scale. The result is decisions that are locally reasonable but globally inefficient.
This program studies how AI-based optimization and decision support can find better solutions — not by replacing human judgment, but by making the structure of complex problems legible.
currentWork: Problem scoping in energy dispatch and building systems. Reviewing optimization approaches used in grid operations and identifying where classical methods consistently produce poor solutions.
futureDirection: Developing optimization methods for real-time energy dispatch under uncertainty — specifically, settings where demand and supply forecasts are unreliable.
